title: Oxford Launches First Human Trial of Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine
detail: The University of Oxford launched the world's first Phase 1 human trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus on 13 July 2026. The BD-Ebov trial, run by the Oxford Vaccine Group and Pandemic Sciences Institute, will evaluate the safety and immune response of the ChAdOx1 BDBV candidate — built on the same viral vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine — in 50 healthy adults aged 18-55. The Serum Institute of India manufactured and stockpiled roughly 620,000 doses within two weeks and supplied 4,000 investigational doses for the study. CEPI is backing the trial, and preparations are underway for additional studies in Uganda through the MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit.

media.caption: Oxford launches first human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine

title: Second US Ebola Patient Evacuated to Germany for Treatment
detail: WHO confirmed that the second American infected with Bundibugyo virus in DRC was medically evacuated to Germany on 13 July 2026 for specialized care. The same day, the US extended its 30-day suspension on entry for travelers recently in DRC, and certain travelers from Uganda or South Sudan; Americans who have recently been in DRC are barred from boarding commercial flights bound directly for the US and must complete a mandatory 21-day stay in a third country before travelling home.

media.caption: 2nd American infected with Ebola in DRC evacuated to Germany, WHO chief says
